scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace apps/api run typecheck && npm --workspace apps/web run typecheck
scripts.build: npm --workspace apps/api run build && npm --workspace apps/web run build
scripts.start: concurrently "npm --workspace apps/api run start" "npm --workspace apps/web run start"
